text:
maya: :wave: Heads-up — we need to rebalance enablement office-hours for the next two weeks. NexaHealth is going live and wants an APAC-friendly workshop + a renewal touchpoint next month. Who can cover the evening APAC slot?

jess: I can take a late-evening APAC slot on Tue (21:30 SGT ~ 13:30 UTC). Happy to do a 45m walk-through + Q&A.

liam: I can swap the Mon morning EMEA slot with someone if that helps cover overlap. Which exact UTC slots are we deciding on?

maya: Current candidate slots: Tue 13:30 UTC (good EMEA/APAC overlap), Thu 22:00 UTC (APAC prime), Fri 15:00 UTC (Americas-friendly). Let's do a quick emoji poll — react :one: for Tue 13:30, :two: for Thu 22:00, :three: for Fri 15:00. :calendar:

olivia: I'm OOO Tue, can do Thu 22:00 though — marking :two:.

sahil: I can take Fri 15:00. Also recommend we include a short runbook snippet and a renewal checklist in the agenda for NexaHealth. Draft agenda I can paste below.

sahil: ```
Agenda (45m):
- 00-05m: Intros & goal check (what success looks like)
- 05-20m: Migration checklist + routing policy walkthrough
- 20-35m: Live demo of dedicated-to-hosted fallback and autoscaling settings
- 35-40m: Renewal/health signals & recommended touchpoints
- 40-45m: Q&A + next steps / doc links
Runbook snippet: ensure canary deploy -> staggered rollouts -> fallback to smaller model variant on capacity alerts.
```

jess: That looks great. Please add a line for "renewal metrics we'll surface" under the health signals.

maya: Added. I'll update the calendar event and send the invite. Calendar link: https://cal.company.com/event?eid=xyz-nexa. cs-bot, please schedule a signup reminder 24h before. :thumbsup:

cs-bot: Reminder scheduled: signup closes in 24 hours. :alarm_clock:

liam: One more ops ask — who will own feedback capture and the post-session follow-up? I can collate notes if someone posts a template.

maya: Assigning liam to feedback capture. Use this quick template in the meeting notes: 1) top 3 friction points, 2) feature asks, 3) any red flags for renewal (yes/no + reason), 4) next steps + owners. Ping me if you need example prompts to extract preservation-of-evidence from recordings.

jess: I'll drop a short intro slide deck link in the event and add a line about recording consent.

olivia: Marked. Thanks team — I'll react to confirm once the calendar is updated. :white_check_mark:
